title: external asset owner transfer settlement (loan 12, transfer 28)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture transfer-28-je-post.json (COB settlement of external-asset-owner transfer 28 on loan 12, tenant gerege; business date 2026-09-02, COB settled it as transfer 28 ACTIVE effective 2026-09-03). request.loan_id=12 is transferData.loan.loanId; request.transfer_id=28 is transferData.transferId. All nine row cells are that same object: expect.owner_external_id="SEED-Inv-01" is transferData.owner.externalId; expect.loan_external_id="OHLGT-L03" is transferData.loan.externalId; expect.transfer_external_id="OHINVW-Tr-12" is transferData.transferExternalId; expect.purchase_price_ratio="97.25" is transferData.purchasePriceRatio (a decimal STRING, no integer-minor-unit form); expect.status="ACTIVE"; expect.settlement_date="2026-09-02"; expect.effective_from="2026-09-03"; expect.effective_to="9999-12-31". expect.details transcribes transferData.details into integer minor units (MNT, 2 digits): total_principal_outstanding_minor=10000000 from totalPrincipalOutstanding 100000.000000; total_interest_outstanding_minor=661853 from 6618.530000; total_fee_charges_outstanding_minor=10000 from 100.000000; total_penalty_charges_outstanding_minor=5700 from 57.000000; total_outstanding_minor=10677553 from totalOutstanding 106775.530000; total_overpaid_minor=0 from totalOverpaid 0.000000. The oracle's stored total is the sum of the four buckets, and the port DERIVES it (investor.ExternalAssetOwnerTransferDetails.DeriveTotalOutstanding = principal+interest+fee+penalty), so a derivation that drops fee (10000) or penalty (5700) diverges; fee and penalty are non-zero AND DIFFERENT, so both drops are discriminated. expect.journal transcribes journalEntryData: 10 entries ids 119-128, entry_count=10; debit_total_minor=21355106 from 213551.060000 and credit_total_minor=21355106 from 213551.060000 (debits==credits); posted_amount_minor=10677553 is the Transfers-Suspense leg (glAccountCode OHLGR-10011) of 106775.530000, i.e. the FULL outstanding, never purchase_price_ratio x outstanding. DB corroboration in the same capture directory: db-transfer-details-ohinvy.txt shows asset_owner_transfer_id=28 with the same six amounts, db-je-transfer-ohinvy.txt shows the ten entries with transaction_id=I28, and db-transfer-je-mapping-ohinvy.txt maps all ten journal_entry_id 119-128 to owner_transfer_id=28. LIMITATION: total_overpaid is 0.0, so this capture CANNOT discriminate whether overpaid is excluded from the total -- including or excluding zero both give 10677553. A drive that folds overpaid in would kill ZERO on this corpus and is deliberately NOT registered; a capture of a loan overpaid at transfer time is required before that can be vectorised. Nothing was computed by this promotion beyond the x100 minor-unit transcription of the observed decimal strings.

provenance.note: All expect cells are transcribed from the committed capture transfer-28-je-post.json; capture_case_id names the observed transferExternalId. The same directory's db-transfer-details-ohinvy.txt and db-transfer-je-mapping-ohinvy.txt corroborate the details snapshot and the owner_transfer_id=28 provenance of all ten journal entries.
